description: This file defines a helper class `tlInputParameter` for handling input parameters (from POST/GET/REQUEST), along with related classes for validation (`tlStringValidationInfo`, `tlIntegerValidationInfo`, etc.) and parameter info (`tlParameterInfo`). It appears to be part of the TestLink project, focusing on input processing and validation.

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Helper class for managing input parameters fetched from POST/GET/REQUEST, including normalization and validation.

classes.name: tlParameterInfo
classes.description: Class holding information about a specific input parameter, such as source and name.

classes.name: tlStringValidationInfo
classes.description: Class for string validation and normalization, supporting trimming, length checks, regex, and custom functions.

classes.name: tlIntegerValidationInfo
classes.description: Class for validating integer input parameters against min/max bounds and custom validation.

classes.name: tlArrayValidationInfo
classes.description: Class for validating arrays of values, applying a validation info to each element.

classes.name: tlCheckBoxValidationInfo
classes.description: Class for normalizing and validating checkbox boolean inputs submitted via forms.

methods.name: tlInputParameter::__construct
methods.description: Constructor that fetches, normalizes, and validates the input parameter based on provided info.

methods.name: tlInputParameter->value
methods.description: Returns the validated normalized value if fetched and valid, else null.
